subject: Follow-up: data ownership RACI + procurement timeline request
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reyes <samantha.reyes@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: data ownership RACI + procurement timeline request

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the time today. Appreciate you walking us through the pilot scope and the internal goals (reduce inference cost, centralize model serving, and lock down PHI handling). A few quick items we promised to follow up on and a request to help us map the remaining approval path so we can align Lakehouse->Prod rollout dates: 

1) Decision roles: could you share a short RACI (who is Responsible/Accountable/Consulted/Informed) for the pilot and for procurement/signoff? In particular, who is the economic buyer and who owns data access approvals?

2) Security/legal touchpoints: we heard there will be a SOC2 + custom DPA review. Please list the right people (name + email) your security or legal team will want involved.

3) Procurement timing: if procurement needs a statement of work (SOW) or PO in advance, what is your typical lead time? Any standard legal terms we should be aware of?

4) Decision criteria: if you can share the top 3 criteria the exec sponsor will use to greenlight production (e.g., latency, inference cost per 1k tokens, auditability), that will help us prepare a one-page summary for them.

I attached a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) draft with proposed owners and a sample timeline we can iterate on (redwood-mappilot-v0.3.xlsx). If it helps, we can also run a 30-minute working session with your security and procurement folks next week to accelerate alignment.

Next steps I propose:
- You: share RACI + security/legal contact list by Wed 6/13
- Us: update MAP + provide SOC2 + DPA links after we have the names
- Schedule: working session w/ security & procurement (30m) — does Thu 6/14 or Fri 6/15 work?

Thanks — I’ll flag Ben and Marissa who will support procurement/SOW/technical Qs.

Best,
Lauren
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0182

Attachment: redwood-mappilot-v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Samantha Reyes <samantha.reyes@orbithealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@orbithealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: data ownership RACI + procurement timeline request

Hi Lauren —

Great to meet the team — thanks for the clear recap. See notes inline below and a very short RACI we maintain for pilots. I pasted the RACI rows into this reply to make it easy: 

- Exec sponsor / economic buyer: Miguel Alvarez (miguel.alvarez@orbithealth.com) — final sign-off on budget and long-term commitments.
- Data steward / owner: Priya Menon (priya.menon@orbithealth.com) — approves dataset extracts and runtime access for PHI-scoped features.
- InfoSec reviewer: Tom Hargreaves (tom.h@orbitsec.orbithealth.com) — handles SOC2/DPA questions.
- Legal: procurement@orbithealth.com (contracts@orbithealth.com) — front door for SOW, terms, PO.

RACI (pilot):
- Responsible: Product owner (Emily Zhou)
- Accountable: Miguel Alvarez
- Consulted: Data steward (Priya), InfoSec (Tom), Legal (procurement@orbithealth.com)
- Informed: Platform engineering leads

Procurement timing: for pilots we typically do a 2–4 week review for SOW + DPA if there are no custom clauses; SOC2 paperwork is fast if you can provide the attestation PDF and the security questionnaire answers. If there are redlines we budget an extra 1–2 weeks.

We can do a working session with Tom and procurement on Thu 6/14 at 11:00am PT. That works for us — please confirm and send a calendar invite. 

Thanks — attaching the internal procurement intake form (no need to fill entirely, but good to bring key billing info to the call).

— Sam
Samantha Reyes
Director, ML Ops
OrbitHealth
samantha.reyes@orbithealth.com

I’ll schedule the working session once you confirm availability. If either of you prefer a prep call beforehand, I can do 15m tomorrow morning.

Thanks — Lauren
